level00.imageAlt: Archaeological excavation camp in the desert
level00.captionInitial: You have arrived at the excavation camp.
level00.captionCompleted: The first signal from the Iris Core has been detected.
level00.title: Tartessos Quest
level00.paragraph1: An archaeological expedition has discovered a sealed entrance beneath the southern sands. Everything suggests it leads to a hidden chamber of ancient Tartessos.
level00.paragraph2: Inside, there is no ordinary treasure, but the remains of a technology impossible for its time: a network of knowledge the Tartessians called IRIS.
level00.paragraph3: Your mission is to decipher its mechanisms, restore its chambers, and overcome the trials protecting each fragment of Tartessian memory.
level00.paragraph4: Code glyphs, living records, oracle queries, secret routes, forgotten languages, and deep memories will be the keys to awakening the core.
level00.successParagraph1: The Tartessos Quest interface has been successfully deployed at the exploration camp.
level00.successParagraph2: The surface systems are responding. The expedition can begin its descent toward the first Tartessian threshold.
level00.hint: Next mission: establish the first link with the dormant technology beneath the ruins of Tartessos.

level01.captionInitial: The expedition must register your name before granting access to the remains of Tartessos.
level01.captionCompleted: The form has been received successfully.
level01.title: ADVENTURER NAME
level01.paragraph1: Before beginning the adventure, you must register in the expedition log that will guide the exploration of the sealed chambers of Tartessos.
level01.paragraph2: Open the Tartessos.Quest.Boot class and change the value of the ADVENTURERNAME parameter to your name.
level01.paragraph3: Then compile the class and press SUBMIT FORM to transmit your registration to the expedition log.
level01.successMessage: The form has been received successfully.
level01.genericValidationError: The form could not be validated.
level01.connectionError: Communication with the Tartessian core could not be established.
